method: BASELINE, second layer beside baseline-2026-11 (untouched). Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module (built-in functions, no daydate), the rules in one module and the survivor's questions in a seat module importing it; no regulative rule (the focus sets no duty with a deadline); no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
focus: equivalents: the Northern Territory's equivalents of the child abuse reforms (limitation removal, setting aside earlier judgments and settlements; organisational liability is in the Personal Injuries (Liabilities and Damages) Act 2003 Part 3A, encoded beside that Act)

scope: Focus: the child abuse provisions. In: s 5 (as it bears on s 5A), s 5A(1)-(6), s 53(1), (2), s 54(1)-(7), s 55 (s 4 'judgment' in finding 5). Out: the rest of the Act (in baseline-2026-11); organisational liability (Personal Injuries (Liabilities and Damages) Act 2003 Part 3A, encoded in that subject's baseline-2026-11); the court's powers saved by s 5A(5) beyond its note. Reasons in NOTES.md.
questions: Was what was done to me child abuse
Is there a time limit on my child abuse action
Can the court still dismiss or stay my action for delay
Can I sue now after my earlier case
Can this court set aside my earlier judgment or settlement
What may the court take into account from my earlier case
